status: Technical proposal only; gameplay mask and native human scale verified, architectural coordinates are generation constraints and must be measured again on output

projection.meaning: Directions of projected architectural lines measured/approximated from inspected own lumber hut and sawmill. These are 2D image slopes, not inferred 3D camera elevation/azimuth or a rotated game grid.
projection.direction_rule: All corresponding front eaves, ridge, beam, sill and lintel edges rise to the right at the same approximate slope. Left depth edges descend right. Verticals remain vertical; visible left side modest. Preserve original hip-roof storehouse identity.

proposed_ground.note: A projected contact envelope inside the square collision area, not a replacement gameplay footprint or a requirement to fill every occupied square with visible masonry.

door.opening_rule: Maintain actual 38worldpx vertical clearance after uniform scaling; do not change people or stretch image axes.

landing.note: Flat low landing tongue connects oblique doorway to the actual middle entrance; it has a horizontal front toe entirely at y800, not a sloping toe extending below the south boundary. Shallow means low height above ground, not a short projected ground span. All stone is within the E cell; none in exterior approach.

wall_wireframe.status: Spatial orientation illustration only; not final eave/roof/chimney height

human.meaning: Same real carrier as v1 verified guide, 132guidepx =33worldpx, separate scale reference only; never put person into warehouse master

preserved_state_contract.day: Door open, no indoor figure or stock props
preserved_state_contract.night: Same registered geometry, door closed, separate window light/chimney smoke driven by actual legitimate sleeping guests
